notes.title: Localization & Quality of Life!
notes.content:
[h1]🌍 New Experimental Languages[/h1]
We’ve added support for the following languages in an [b]experimental*[/b] state:
[list]
[*] Chinese (Simplified) (中文（简体）)
[*] Spanish (Español)
[*] French (Français)
[*] Italian (Italiano)
[*] Japanese (日本語)
[*] Norwegian (Norsk)
[*] Polish (Polski)
[*] Portuguese (Brazil) (Português do Brasil)
[*] Russian (Русский)
[/list]
[b]*experimental[/b] means that we, the developers, do not speak this language and therefore cannot guarantee its quality or playability. We hope it is good enough to play and aim to improve it over time with the help of the community.

If you try one of these languages, we’d love to hear your thoughts. Is it playable? Are there any major issues? Start a discussion in the Community Hub and let us know.
Your feedback can directly help us improve it!

[h3]🙏 Thanks for Your Support[/h3]
A huge thank you to everyone for your incredible feedback and kind reviews, they truly mean the world to us and help the game reach more players. 💗

[b]Take care,[/b]
René & Nikolai

notes.title: Achievements, Localization & More!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

First of all, a huge [b]Thank You[/b] for all the amazing feedback and kind words we’ve received so far! It’s incredibly motivating to see how people are enjoying our game. These positive reviews really helped us jump back in, polish the game, and iron out some of the rough edges. And that’s exactly what we did over the last couple of weeks!

[h2]🌍 Localization[/h2]

We’ve implemented localization, meaning we can now add more languages to the game over time.
[list]
[*] Since we’re both [b]German[/b]🥔 it’s the first additional language we’ve added and tested!
[*] For the English version we fixed typos, improved grammar, and reworked a lot of dialogue to make everything flow better.
[*] We plan to add[b] Italian, Chinese, Russian, Japanese, Spanish…[/b] and more in the future. However, these will be [b]"experimental"[/b] since we don’t have the language expertise to proofread everything ourselves. So if you spot some… creative translations, you’ll know why. 😅
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248385/0d4ab819a172bd85ee1f73e97abed9b54676e1da.png[/img]

[h2]🏆 Achievements, Because Who Doesn’t Love a Challenge?[/h2]

We’ve added [b]Achievements[/b] to Care! 
But beware, many of them are [b]cryptically worded[/b] and not so easy to figure out. 

We actually expect some of them to be super duper hard to solve, so keep that in mind 😛
Happy Achievement hunting!

[h2]✨ Polishing & Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]

We’ve fine-tuned several aspects of the game, making small but meaningful improvements to enhance the experience:
[list]
[*] Added more checkpoints in areas where we felt they were needed.
[*] Improved quest descriptions to give better context on what you’re supposed to do.
[*] General refinements across the board to make everything feel smoother and more polished.
[/list]
We [b]hope[/b] your old saves will still work fine. We’ve tested it and they should, but we can’t 100% guarantee it. 🤞

Once again, thank you for all the love, feedback, and engagement! We hope to hear more from you!
Enjoy the update and have a great time playing!
[b]Take Care,[/b]
💗
René & Nikolai
